Imperial|small: TIEs stay the screen, but no single mark over a third, and the Lambda flies with them, so the screen reads as several jobs.
Imperial|escort: Three distinct escort hulls in near-equal shares; the Arquitens' longer dagger is the largest share because it is the line's picket.
Imperial|capital: The Victory's dagger is the largest share, but the Carrack and Quasar Fire put non-dagger capitals in every line.
Minbari|small: The Nial remains the Minbari fighter; the reshaped Tishat and the Flyer give the screen three plans instead of one.
Minbari|escort: Torotha and Tinashi carry most of the line; the slim Leshath scout breaks up the three-fin silhouette.
Minbari|capital: The Sharlin is now dealt as a normal capital (the old roll's r<.94?4:5 cutoff never reached it).
Shadows|small: Shadow fighters outnumber scouts, as the vessels carry them; Drakh raiders are the servants' screen.
Shadows|escort: The hunter is the Shadows' own frigate; heavy raiders give the line a second, non-crab plan.
Shadows|capital: The battlecrab stays half the line; hybrid and Drakh cruiser keep it from being one crab at every size.
EarthForce|small: The Aurora stays the most common; the Thunderbolt and the shuttle keep it under half.
EarthForce|escort: Olympus and Sagittarius in equal shares; the Olympus drive layouts add plans inside the class.
EarthForce|capital: Five capital plans; Hyperion and Omega lead as the war's workhorses, Nova and Poseidon add the heavy line.
Federation|small: Fighter, runabout and shuttle: three small-craft jobs.
Federation|escort: Five escort classes in near-equal shares, as the old roll had them.
Federation|capital: Four heavy classes in equal shares.
Klingon|small: Shuttle, heavy fighter and To'Duj in near-equal shares.
Klingon|escort: The D7 flies here only, so the capital band is not D7s beside the K't'inga they grew into.
Klingon|capital: K't'inga, B'rel, F15 and Vor'cha: four silhouettes, none over a third.
Borg|small: The small band was 95% probes on main; the scout and assimilated shuttle give it three plans.
Borg|escort: Probe, assimilated vessel and diamond in near-equal shares.
Borg|capital: The sphere and diamond are joined by the tactical cube (under the crown threshold), so no capital plan is half the line.
Mondoshawan|small: Five small classes; the cab and police cruiser are now different bodies.
Mondoshawan|escort: The Mondoshawan ship was 71% of the escort band; the yacht and the Mangalore assault ship now share it.
Mondoshawan|capital: Main had no normal capital-band class at all (0% reach); the battle cruiser and liner come from the fleet's own library.
USCM|small: The Cheyenne stays the largest share; the lander, shuttle and EEV keep it under half.
USCM|escort: The escort band was 98% Conestoga transports; the Bison star freighter now shares it.
USCM|capital: Three capital classes in near-equal shares, as before.
Engineers|small: Main's screen was one horseshoe; skiff, chair gunship and ampule dart share it.
Engineers|escort: Main's line was the same horseshoe; Sentinel, orrery and ampule carrier share it.
Engineers|capital: The Juggernaut stays two thirds of the capital line, in four structural variants; the temple ship is the rest.
Yautja|small: The scout ship was 59% of the screen; pod, Enforcer and Prey ship share it.
Yautja|capital: Capital jobs used to fall back to Wolf scouts (41% reach); the barge and clan ship are real capitals.
Romulans|small: Main's small band was only the shuttle; the Scorpion and drone ship join it.
Romulans|escort: The scout was a half-size bird-of-prey on main; it and the TOS bird-of-prey now have their own plans.
Romulans|capital: D'deridex and Valdore as before, with the Scimitar.
Dominion|small: The attack ship stays the largest share; Hideki and shuttle (never in the old pool) share the rest.
Dominion|escort: The heavy escort was the attack ship at twice the size; it now has its own plan, and the Galor/Keldon is the Cardassian line.
Dominion|capital: Battlecruiser, battleship (now in the normal pool) and Breen warship in near-equal shares.
Space Marines|small: Five small craft, none over a quarter. The boarding torpedo is modelled but out of the pool: in clay it read as the Yard's small craft.
Space Marines|escort: Hunter, Gladius and Nova were one armoured spine on main; each has its own plan now, with the Stormbird.
Space Marines|capital: Strike cruiser leads; the leaner Vanguard, the barge and the space hulk share the rest.
Tesla|small: Optimus robots were 75% of the screen; Starlink, Dragon and Cybertruck share it.
Tesla|escort: Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy, each with its configurations (legs, payload).
Tesla|capital: Starship and the stack with the Gigafactory carrier.
